title: Constructed endpoint comparisons for horizontal duality mates
statement: Fix the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common universe. Restrict derived pullbacks to QCoh [def-pc-derived-pullback] and qcqs derived direct images to QCoh [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Fix the coherent composition and identity comparisons of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and the corresponding pinned derived adjunctions [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For f:X→Y qcqs, g:Y′→Y and h:Z→Y′, with Y,Y′,Z qcqs, set P=(X×_Y Y′)×_{Y′} Z, Q=X×_Y Z and e:P≅Q [def-pc-fibre-product]. For any E in D(O_X), define s_E:Lpr₁* Lg_X* E≅Le* Lg_{X,Z}* E by the composition comparisons and e.hom≫g_{X,Z}=pr₁≫g_X. For supplied right adjoints c,d to R(Q→Z) and R(P→Z), define r_K:d(Lh*Lg*K)≅Le*c(L(h≫g)*K). First apply d to the QCoh pullback composition comparison; then use right-adjoint uniqueness after transport across the equivalence Le*. The left-functor comparison is the conjugate of the pinned pullback comparison, composed with R(e.hom)≅L(e.inv)* from uniqueness of right adjoints. These are actual constructed isomorphisms; no duality mate or base-change invertibility is needed.

proof.text: Lift the fixed ambient pullback composition and identity isomorphisms to the full QCoh subcategories by preimageIso. Their comparisons for a scheme isomorphism and its inverse exhibit pullback along that isomorphism as an equivalence. The projection equation yields the displayed ambient source comparison.

Restrict the pinned pullback/direct-image adjunction to QCoh. Conjugate the fixed pullback composition iso to obtain the direct-image composition iso. For e:P≅Q, right-adjoint uniqueness gives R(e.hom)≅L(e.inv)*. Thus R(P→Z)≅L(e.inv)*⋙R(Q→Z). Transport the composite adjunction L(e.inv)*⋙R(Q→Z)⊣c⋙L(e.hom)* along that left-functor iso and use right-adjoint uniqueness with the supplied adjunction for d. Compose its component with d applied to Lg*⋙Lh*≅L(h≫g)*, then forget to the ambient category. All maps and isomorphisms are constructed in Lean, with no new proof holes.

def horizontalMateTargetIso {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ Y')
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f (h ≫ g)))
    (d : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h))
    (adjc : @horizontalMatePushforward _ (pullback f (h ≫ g)) Z _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _
      (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) _ _ ⊣ c)
    (adjd : @horizontalMatePushforward _ (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h) Z _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) _ _
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) _ _ ⊣ d)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    (d.obj ((horizontalMatePullback h).obj ((horizontalMatePullback g).obj K))).obj ≅
      (derivedPullback (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h).hom).obj
        (c.obj ((horizontalMatePullback (h ≫ g)).obj K)).obj
